**In one line**: After months of policy friction, President Trump reportedly dined with Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei.

### Key points
- The Times of India reported that President Trump and Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei shared a dinner.
- The two sides had reportedly been at odds for months over the direction of AI regulation and policy.
- The meeting is being read as a possible thaw between safety-focused Anthropic and the administration.

### Why it matters
Direct dialogue between a frontier AI lab and the White House can shape where regulation, procurement, and safety standards land. A meeting point between Amodei — a vocal advocate for AI regulation — and Trump could ripple across the broader policy landscape for the industry.
